findings.finding: The release cuts FY OP 2,500m -> 2,000m (-20%), 経常 2,540m -> 2,070m (-18.5%, 18.5% below the IFIS consensus, which sat exactly on the old plan), NI 1,450m -> 1,070m (-26.2%) with an impairment in H1; H1 経常 901m was 21.7% below IFIS and Q2 alone fell 29% YoY with 経常 margin 5.3% -> 3.3%. Released 09:00 JST, so the spot holds the first ~4.2% of the reaction; the residual into the window is the sell-through of a crowded margin long against the analog's flat next day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same line, same quarter last year: on 2025-10-03 (09:00 release) the FY 経常 cut 3,000m -> 2,300m, 17.3% below IFIS; Yahoo daily bars give O -0.1% H +0.5% L -5.1% C -4.3% vs prior close, then 2025-10-06 C -4.3% (flat), 2025-10-07 -5.7%. Other 09:00 prints (2025-07-03, 2026-01-05, 2026-07-03) all closed above their intraday low and were within +/-0.15% the next session. Today: low -6.1% at 09:02, -4.22% at 09:50.
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it IS priced: it was public an hour before the seal and the spot is already -4.22% with 3x normal volume by 09:50. What is not obviously done: the cut this year reaches NI -26% and puts FY profit below the prior year, versus a similar-size cut last year that ended the day at -4.3%; with 信用倍率 6.38 the leveraged long has more to sell. If the market had fully absorbed it, the stock would sit at or below last year's full reaction; it sits at it, with the low already 1.8 points under.
findings.independence: Kabutan/MINKABU PRESS coverage of the same release (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2753&b=n202610050223) and the Monex/IFIS comparison (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/2753_20261005_act_20261005_090011_1) are readings of the same document; the reaction analog comes from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2753.T?range=3y&interval=1d).

findings.finding: Second consecutive H1 downgrade, and the new FY guide implies H2 OP of 1,153m (2,000 - 847) against 1,223m in the prior-year H2 (2,209 - 986), only -5.7% YoY, while Q2 just printed 経常 -29% YoY and the company says the cost pressures continue into H2; the guide still looks generous, and credibility is now two cuts deep.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2025-10-03 cut (FY 経常 3,000 -> 2,300, 2026/3 actual came in at 2,344, i.e. the cut was enough), the stock drifted -5.7% by the second session after the print; the drift ended there. There is no prior instance of a second consecutive cut to compare.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline wire (kabutan's 'H2 経常 -10.7%' line) prints the H2 arithmetic but not against the Q2 run-rate; a market that had priced a further cut would be trading on a PER well below the 25.3x it shows on the revised EPS of 52.08. The actual next cut, if any, resolves outside the window, so only the drift from re-reading the guide counts here.
findings.independence: Shares the 決算短信 and revision notice with finding 1. Last year's cut from Monex/IFIS (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/2753_20251003_act_20251003_090015_1) is a different document.

findings.finding: Dividend held at 34 yen (17 interim paid 2026-12-16, 17 year-end), no revision, no buyback, 株主優待 unchanged (record month March only): the payout rises to ~65% of the revised EPS of 52.08, and the 2.58% yield plus the 優待 (3.34% combined) is the support the retail register leans on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dividend change at either of the last two H1 prints; last year's held dividend did not stop a -4.3% day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is inside what the company already guided, so mostly priced; the only incremental content is that a cut was possible and did not come, which a holder deciding whether to sell the remaining session can weigh.
findings.independence: Kabutan 優待 page (https://kabutan.jp/stock/yutai?code=2753) for the 優待 terms and yield; same 短信 for the dividend.

findings.finding: September 月次 published with the results: group sales +4.5% all-store, 既存店 +2.1% (H1 既存店 +2.8%), so revenue is on plan (H1 19,960m vs 20,000m); but the core 焼肉 segment's existing-store customer count fell to 94.9% in September after 99.4% in August, the weakest month of the half.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Monthly sales have not been where this stock moves; the 2025-10-03 and 2026-10-05 misses are margin, not sales.

findings.finding: 信用倍率 6.38x with no disclosed shorts and the name not 貸借 (制度信用 buy-side only): the margin register is one-sided long, so the forced-selling channel after a 6% intraday drop runs only one way and nothing covers into it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the last four 09:00 negative prints the next session was flat (-0.15% to +0.14%), so margin liquidation has not shown up as visible next-day selling on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline's lean already carries a -0.40 margin_overhang component, so this mostly agrees with the priced lean; kept at a token size because agreement with positioning is not an edge.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the priced lean (-0.14, margin overhang) and the -5.25% run-up, and the release itself is already in the spot; the strongest positive the release could carry (a held dividend, sales on plan, 悪材料出尽くし after a cut the size of last year's, a stock already 1.9 points off its 09:02 low) was looked for and found, which is why p_up sits at 45 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on information the market already has -> p_up toward 50): the release was public an hour before the seal, so finding 1 went -0.6 -> -0.4 and finding 2 -0.3 -> -0.2, and p_up 42 -> 45; abs_move_pct left at 1.8.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positive (held dividend, sales on plan, intraday recovery off the low) is written into baseline_tension; it was already searched, so it moved p_up only via rule 1.
The positioning finding was cut -0.2 -> -0.1 because it restates the baseline lean's margin_overhang component (file guidance: a finding that agrees with positioning is not an edge).
